#  41418 - Language Skills Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **41418 - module is no longer offered from WS 2011/12**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Language Skills**  |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 4 - Environmental Sciences and Process Engineering   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. PD Dr.-Ing. habil. Molkenthin, Frank 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every winter semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | Part A: English Conversation Part B: German for Foreigners  |  
| Contents:  | Part A is defined as an intensive language training in English as main instruction language used in a majority of modules The module’s validation is obtained in English with a TOEFL score of 575 or greater, by an IELTS score of 6.5 or greater; examination is at UNUT Part B is defined as a language course in a second European language (French, German, Spanish and eventually Hungarian) used by the members of the consortium (especially used by host institution for the specialisation – semester 3). The validation is obtained in a similar way according to each specific language certification system.  |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Lecture / 40 Hours 
  * Self organised studies / 50 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | Lecture notes  |  
| Module Examination:  | Unspecified - Specification from winter semester 2016/17 required!  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | English TOEFL 575  |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  | Location: BTUC & othersDetails: http://www.euroaquae.orgExam TOEFL English in Newcastle  |  
| Module Components:  | None  |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |
